name: us-sauna-cold-plunge-venue-data
title: US Sauna & Cold Plunge Venue Data
description: Cold plunge, sauna and contrast-therapy venues across the US metros that findsaunaplunge.com covers. Every record carries the date its details were last checked, and every published temperature and price is traceable to the venue's own page (source URL, capture date, verbatim quote). An absent field means the venue does not publish that detail, never zero. Monthly snapshots of the live feed at https://findsaunaplunge.com/api/v1/venues.json.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable venue id; also the last path segment of url

fields.name: status
fields.description: community | brand_import | verified — how the record was checked

fields.name: lastVerified
fields.description: Date the venue's own pages were last read

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Chain or franchise slug, where applicable

fields.name: citySlug
fields.description: Metro the venue is listed under; metros may span state lines

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Geocoded from the address; empty when no reliable pin exists

fields.name: modalities
fields.description: Pipe-separated modality slugs (cold_plunge, traditional_sauna, infrared_sauna, steam_room, red_light, cryotherapy, compression, …)

fields.name: priceFrom
fields.description: Pipe-separated names of price columns the venue publishes only as a floor ("from $29")

fields.name: hours
fields.description: Opening hours as the venue publishes them

fields.name: url
fields.description: The venue's page on findsaunaplunge.com, showing the source and date behind every figure

resources.name: venues-json
resources.title: Venues (feed as published, with per-fact sources)
resources.description: The findsaunaplunge.com feed exactly as published. Each venue carries a sources object: for every published fact, the sourceUrl it came from, the capturedOn date that page was read, and a verbatim quote supporting it.
